The '''Arab Institute for Statistics''' ({{langx|ar|المعهد العربي للتدريب والبحوث والإحصاء}}), formally the '''Arab Institute for Training and Research in Statistics''' ('''AITRS''') ({{langx|ar|المعهد العربي للتدريب والبحوث والإحصاء}}) is an intergovernmental statistical institute serving the National Statistical Offices in all [[Arab League]] countries. It was established in 1971 by the [[United Nations Development Programme]] (UNDP) under the name "Regional Institute for training and Research in Statistics for the Near East".

== Board of trustees ==
The Board of Trustees is composed of the heads of the national statistical offices in all [[Arab League]] countries. They meet once per year.
